focalTrait.name: Leaf area
focalTrait.target: community-weighted mean based on species mean traits; not individual leaf measurements or leaf-area index

windowNotes: All coordinates are display windows into unchanged author PNGs. Leaf views and legend use the same lower Americas panel. Upper and lower panels have separate color ranges. AOA panel summarizes multiple well-performing traits, not a leaf-area-specific mask.

weightExample.meaning: Illustrative relative-cover weights only; no field observations or new trait values

results.scaleLabel: 1 km², as reported in the article
results.validation: five-fold spatial cross-validation against held-out sPlot-derived CWM

source: Lusk et al. (2026), Nature Communications 17, 1203; public author repository figures
